lines.en: The clearing below holds nothing but snow.
The frost on my wing edges is thicker today.
In the snow night, my wings look like bark.

lines.zh: 雪原上飞起来，翅边都结霜。
lines.en: Flying over snow, frost crusts my wing edges.
I fold my wings and glide over the drift.
Even in cold weather, I fly.

lines.zh: 西风把我的翅膀推歪了。
lines.en: The west wind pushes my wings askew.

lines.zh: 云散了，雪光刺得我眯眼。
lines.en: The clouds part; the snow glare makes me squint.

lines.zh: 我升到雪原上，翅膀发白。
lines.en: I rise above the snowy plain, wings pale.
I knock snow off the pine boughs.

lines.zh: 雪面反着光，我贴得更低。
lines.en: The snow glare pushes me lower.

lines.zh: 前面有片没冻住的水洼。
lines.en: There is an unfrozen pool ahead.
Above the snowfield there are no signposts.

lines.zh: 我沿着云杉的枝尖绕行。
lines.en: I trace a path along the spruce tips.
Cold wind carries me over the snowbank.
In the snow, do not hit that tree.
The firs are quiet enough to sting.
I wait on a pine branch for the snow to stop.

lines.zh: 白茫茫的，连鸟影也没有。
lines.en: All white, not even a bird's shadow.
A little ice clings to my antennae.

lines.zh: 树皮缝里，还留着我的卵。
lines.en: My eggs still wait in the bark crack.

lines.zh: 我停在一根冻硬的枝条上。
lines.en: I settle on a branch frozen hard.
Who's moving under the snow?
It's the scent of cedar resin.

lines.zh: 雪针叶林里，我翅边发黄。
lines.en: In the snowy taiga, my wing edges yellow.

lines.zh: 雪落下来，我数着每一片。
lines.en: Snow falls; I count every flake.
woods has this one perk.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合得像一片枯叶。
lines.en: I close my wings like a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 我绕你转，翅缘的霜在闪。
lines.en: I circle you, frost glinting on my wing edges.

lines.zh: 我在你帽檐的雪上停着。
lines.en: I'm resting on the snow on your hood.

lines.zh: 雪地上我的黑翅很显眼。
lines.en: My dark wings stand out on snow.
My eggs are in that spruce.
The breath you let out is warm.

lines.zh: 你手里那片叶子是什么？
lines.en: What is that leaf in your hand?
The snow is too bright; your face is a dark shape.

lines.zh: 可你的手太大，我躲远些。
lines.en: But your hands are too big; I keep my distance.
You've caved in the snow I rested on.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我停在你袖口。
lines.en: In the taiga, I land on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 雪地里我的翅膀沾了霜。
lines.en: My wings gathered frost in the snow.
I flounder in the snow, unable to fly straight.
The snowfield cold stiffens my wings.
I think a wing bone has cracked.

lines.zh: 雪落在我翅上，压得我飞低。
lines.en: Snow on my wings weighs my flight down.
I hide on the spruce's sheltered side.
That one crumpled my wings.

lines.zh: 翅上缺了一块，飞不快了。
lines.en: A piece of my wing is gone; I can't fly fast.
The white edge of my wing is smudged.
The scales along my wing edge are rubbed off.
That bit of sweetness was too little.
The mourning cloak's wings settle first.
I shiver with cold, and still I want it.
I land beside your knuckle.
In the snow, I smell something sweet.
Drop me a crumb.
Is it nectar, or melted sugar?
I'll rest still beside your hand.
Just set the sugar on the snow.

lines.zh: 整个冬天，我只找到这点。
lines.en: All winter, this is all I've found.
I'm knocked off the branch.

lines.zh: 雪团砸过来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: A snowball hits me; I flip over.

lines.zh: 细鳞粉落在雪上，很难找。
lines.en: Fine scales dust the snow, hard to find.

lines.zh: 雪地上推来推去，脚都冷了。
lines.en: Pushed back and forth on snow; my feet are cold.

lines.zh: 你张开手，就把雪路堵了。
lines.en: Your open hands wall off my snowy path.
You block the clearing; I go around.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的黑斗篷很显眼。
lines.en: On the snowfield, my black cloak stands out.
I wobble twice in the air.
In the snowy woods you're quite the lump.
A little powder rubs off my wing edge.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我们一起等春天。
lines.en: On the snowfield we wait for spring.

lines.zh: 雪原上的黑翅，是我的丧服。
lines.en: Black wings over snowfield are my mourning dress.

lines.zh: 翅缘碰翅缘，就算说定了。
lines.en: Wing edge to wing edge, it's settled.
You look beautiful in flight.

lines.zh: 这根冻枝，够我们两个停。
lines.en: This frozen twig fits us both.

lines.zh: 我身上披着雪，你也别害羞。
lines.en: Snow on my wings; don't be shy.

lines.zh: 雪针叶林里，绕树飞一圈。
lines.en: One circle around a snowy spruce.
Our wings rise and fall together.

lines.zh: 我的深色翅膀，在雪上最显眼。
lines.en: My dark wings stand out most on snow.
Above the snowline there are no other butterflies.
On a snowy branch, I pause.
Useful — so I'll take it.
My legs are too thin; I can only pinch it.
The bark crack is nearly full.

lines.zh: 这点碎屑，我藏到树皮缝里。
lines.en: I'll hide these crumbs in a bark crevice.

lines.zh: 冻僵的叶子上，什么味也没有。
lines.en: The frozen leaf smells of nothing.
The pine needle is slick; I grip harder.
On the snowfield, dark veins on my wings.
This dry leaf will block the wind.

lines.zh: 积雪针叶林里，我慢慢爬升。
lines.en: In the snowy taiga, I climb slowly.
But your warmth gives you away.

lines.zh: 你惊起的蛾子，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the moth your steps startled up.
Brown wings show clearly on snow.
I drop straight from the treetop.
One moth will feed me two days.

lines.zh: 冷天里出来的，都不好惹。
lines.en: Nothing out in the cold is gentle.

lines.zh: 雪原太亮，我的深色翅显眼。
lines.en: The snowfield is bright; my dark wings show.

lines.zh: 我顺着雪坡的气流俯冲。
lines.en: I dive on the current down the snow slope.
There's no cover on the open snow.

lines.zh: 别抬头，雪已经落下来了。
lines.en: Do not look up; the snow has begun.
I'm skimming almost against the snow.

lines.zh: 热气在冷空气里像一条线。
lines.en: Your warmth trails like a thread in the cold.

lines.zh: 我退到雪光刺眼的那边。
lines.en: I pull back toward the blinding snow.
Snow lands on my wings; I don't shake.
My thin wings brush the cold air softly.
I turn with the brim of your hat.

lines.zh: 深色的翅，贴在雪上很显眼。
lines.en: Dark wings are easy to spot against snow.

lines.zh: 日头一落，我就看不见了。
lines.en: Once the sun sets, I can't see.

lines.zh: 我在等你的动作慢下来。
lines.en: I wait for your movement to slow.

lines.zh: 我的深色翅膀，在雪上不好认。
lines.en: My dark wings are hard to spot on snow.
One press of black wings — not light.

lines.zh: 我撞向你的鼻尖，又弹开。
lines.en: I strike your nose and bounce away.
I brush your face with my wing edge.
This bite is colder than the snow.
Do not struggle; save strength for winter.
Black-edged wings, like a mourning cloak.
The spruce wind speeds me up.
I've got fuzz stuck to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从雪枝上落下来，直奔你。
lines.en: I drop from the snowy branch straight at you.
Caught, wings snapped shut.

lines.zh: 我落在雪里，留下一个印。
lines.en: I land in the snow, leaving a print.
In the snowy night, my wings are hard to see.

lines.zh: 积雪平原的风，把我吹远了。
lines.en: The snowy plain wind carries me off.

lines.zh: 积雪平原的风，把我吹远。
lines.en: Snowfield wind blows me off course.
Only snow, not a single flower.
At the pine edge, snow up to my wings.

lines.zh: 风里有人在叫我的名字。
lines.en: Someone in the wind calls my name.
On the snowfield, I rest on a bare twig.
This is the first time I opened my eyes.
I shake the frost off my wings first.
One touch of fire and my thin wings curl.
I hit the drift; my wings are buried.

lines.zh: 冰水粘住翅膀，我往下沉。
lines.en: The icy water glues my wings; I sink.
A yellow band lines my wing edges.

lines.zh: 雪地上，一片黑落在白里。
lines.en: On the snow, a spot of black in white.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住了我的触角。
lines.en: Purple light tangles around my antennae.

lines.zh: 雪林里，肚子叫得翅膀都停了。
lines.en: In the snow forest, hunger outlouds my wings.

lines.zh: 雷落在云杉上，我整只麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the spruce; I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 没有风，我的翅膀扇不动。
lines.en: No wind — my wings can't move.
